decisions.summary: CiscoMeraki is a workbook-only V3.1 migration (1 Sentinel Workbook + 1 Defender XDR Workbook, 0 Analytic Rules / 0 XDR Custom Detections) packaged at version 3.2.2.
decisions.rationale: Solution contains Workbooks, Hunting Queries, Playbooks, Parser, and Data Connectors, with no Analytic Rules.

decisions.summary: ARM candidate deployment xdrq-pr-template-4d64dc1d2d945f2c succeeded in OptimizeSentinelResourceGroup and Defender XDR Workbook readback was verified via Azure Resource Graph (microsoft.security/workbooks) with installationVerified:true and registrationVerified:true.
decisions.rationale: Verified full V3.1 package deployment and live portal rendering in Defender XDR and Azure Sentinel portals.

decisions.summary: Ingested 14 realistic Cisco Meraki Syslog records via custom DCR and executed all 21/21 workbook queries and 3/3 data connector queries live on Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting with HTTP 200 (19/21 non-zero row parity, 167 total rows on each surface).
decisions.rationale: Verified live CiscoMeraki parser and workbook runtime parity across Log Analytics and Advanced Hunting.

authorExceptions.author: solution-author
authorExceptions.authorJustification: CiscoMeraki is a workbook-only V3.1 migration (1 Sentinel Workbook + 1 Defender XDR Workbook, 0 Analytic Rules / 0 XDR Custom Detections). The V3.1 ARM package deployed cleanly to OptimizeSentinelResourceGroup (deployment xdrq-pr-template-4d64dc1d2d945f2c, provisioningState=Succeeded; TK-Q07 PASS) and Defender Workbook readback is verified via Azure Resource Graph (microsoft.security/workbooks, installationVerified=true, registrationVerified=true in Evidence/receipts/arm-deployment-readback.json). build_qualification_evidence.py marks deployment.passed=false only because the Custom Detection count is 0.

authorExceptions.author: solution-author
authorExceptions.authorJustification: 14 realistic Cisco Meraki Syslog records ( covering MX firewall events, URLs, security_event ids-alerts, airmarshal_events, VPN events, and 8021x client association events) were ingested live via custom DCR into the Syslog table (TK-Q08 PASS, recordsAccepted=14) and verified on both Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting across 19/21 workbook queries and 3/3 data connector queries (Evidence/receipts/workbook-queries-live.json). build_qualification_evidence.py sets mockIngestionVerified=false only because there are 0 XDR Detection pairs.

authorExceptions.author: solution-author
authorExceptions.authorJustification: CiscoMeraki has 0 Analytic Rules / 0 XDR Custom Detections (pairs=0/0). 14 realistic Cisco Meraki Syslog records were ingested via DCR into the Syslog table (Sample Data/Tables/Syslog_mock.json, TK-Q08 PASS) and produced non-zero rows across 19/21 workbook queries and 3/3 data connector queries on both Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting (Evidence/receipts/workbook-queries-live.json).

authorExceptions.author: solution-author
authorExceptions.authorJustification: All 21/21 CiscoMeraki workbook KQL queries executed live with HTTP 200 on both Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting, with 19/21 returning matching non-zero rows (totalRows=167 on both LA and AH; Evidence/receipts/workbook-queries-live.json). The remaining 2 queries (WB-Q19 and WB-Q20) are child detail panels gated on interactive workbook grid row selection ({SourceIP} / {EventRow}) which evaluate to empty filter literals when unbound outside an active row click, while the Defender XDR Workbook UI rendered cleanly in the portal (Evidence/receipts/arm-deployment-readback.json).

authorExceptions.author: solution-author
authorExceptions.authorJustification: CiscoMeraki contains 0 Analytic Rules and 0 XDR Custom Detections, so detection-level validation.sentinel-sdk.json and validation.advanced-hunting.json have total=0. Live Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting API connectivity and query execution were verified across all 21/21 workbook queries and 3/3 data connector queries with HTTP 200 on both surfaces (Evidence/receipts/workbook-queries-live.json).

authorExceptions.author: solution-author
authorExceptions.authorJustification: All 21/21 CiscoMeraki workbook queries and 3/3 data connector queries executed live with HTTP 200 on both Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting (workbook queries executed OK on both surfaces: 21/21; Evidence/receipts/workbook-queries-live.json). build_qualification_evidence.py reports Detections SDK False / AH False only because the solution has 0 Analytic Rules / 0 XDR Custom Detections.

authorExceptions.author: solution-author
authorExceptions.authorJustification: Dual-surface runtime KQL execution was verified across all 21/21 packaged CiscoMeraki workbook queries (HTTP 200 on both Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting, 19/21 non-zero row parity, 167 total rows on each surface) and 3/3 data connector queries (Evidence/receipts/workbook-queries-live.json).

authorExceptions.author: solution-author
authorExceptions.authorJustification: E2E-V04 is the rollup check requiring all qualification-evidence.json sections to be PASS. dataConnectorIngestion (3/3 queries matched), imageRendering, uiTraversal (3/3 portal pages), urlVerification, ARM deployment (TK-Q07 PASS, Defender Workbook readback verified), DCR mock ingestion (TK-Q08 PASS, 14 Syslog records), and dual-surface workbook execution (21/21 HTTP 200, 19/21 non-zero row parity) are all verified; detection-specific sections are waived under workbook-only migration scope.
